bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs, process_info.rs, locale.rs, intents.rs, control.rs, runtime.rs, springboard/ui/src/progress.rs, springboard/sdk/src/error.rs
summary: Notifications, process activity tracking, localized bundles and App Intents have SDK counterparts. A progress tree (unit counts, child shares, cancel and pause) and an error type with domain, code, user info and recovery text now exist. Progress shared across processes, error recovery attempters and XPC-style app extensions have no general API; apps use the control socket RPC instead.

features.feature: Task Management (ProcessInfo activities, sudden termination, thermal state, user activities)
features.note: Activity tracker, sudden termination and thermal state exist. Progress is a tree of unit counts with child shares, fraction, finish, cancel, pause and resume that reach children with cancellation, pausing and resuming handlers, addChild, and current/becomeCurrent/resignCurrent (bifrost_ui::progress, reached as bifrost_app::controls::progress). Average throughput and seconds remaining come from progress_rate (headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-36.rs). Gap: no shared ProgressManager, no publishing progress to other processes, and no Handoff.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Bundle::load and localized! cover strings (en, is). No on-demand resource requests or general bundle resource lookup API documented.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. add_observer/post with sender object and cross-app distributed posts through the shell; user info is string-only; no NotificationQueue coalescing.
Share and Spotlight/intents hooks exist between apps and shell; no generic extension host or item provider API.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 21 tests. AppError carries domain, code, user info, localized description, failure reason, recovery suggestion and options, help anchor and underlying errors. No per-domain user info providers and no recovery attempter; each module keeps its own error enum.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. JSON-RPC control sockets let scripts and agents drive apps (bifrost pc control). No scripting dictionaries, AppleScript engine or user script tasks.

gaps: ProgressManager and publishing progress to other processes; value observation of progress for views
Per-domain error user info providers and a recovery attempter that runs the chosen option
Generic app extension host and NSItemProvider
NotificationQueue coalescing and typed notification payloads
